q: In a doctor's waiting room, there are $14$ seats in a row. $8$ people are waiting to be seen. i) In how many ways can they be seated? ii) Three of the people are all in the same family and they want to sit together. How many ways can this now happen? iii) The family no longer must sit together, but there is someone with a very bad cough who must sit at least one seat away from anyone else. If all arrangements are equally likely, what is the probability that this happens?
